evidenceLimits: Complete relevant families, not the complete dictionary. Omission does not prove absence. Selected senses are non-exhaustive and not independent level assignments. Mapping/source notes are author assertions to assess, not reviewer findings.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling and reading; sense 1 covers going/reporting to work and attendance at work.
rows.sourceNote: Not a general employment or task-performance word. Intransitive suru; route/arrival and attendance emphasis depend on the construction.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling and reading; select grammar predicate sense 1 as the explicit introductory teaching anchor.
rows.sourceNote: The raw predicate gloss does not distinguish grammar from logic, so compiler intent is not inferred. Logic predicate sense 2 is additional recognition. Basic school-grammar predicate examples include verb, adjective and noun-plus-copula; framework limits are explicit.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling and reading; sole sense 1 covers official/business travel.
rows.sourceNote: Work or official assignment away from the usual base, not leisure travel by definition. Intransitive suru; no overnight minimum is inferred.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling and reading; raw lifespan most directly selects biological lifespan sense 1.
rows.sourceNote: Object/service-life sense 2 is additional and receives no independent N2 assignment. Illustrative animal example does not identify or make a lifespan claim about a species.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling and reading; sense 1 covers the leading part and its actor or actress.
rows.sourceNote: The figurative central-person/thing extension is separately corroborated by the actual inspected public Japanese entry, not assigned a fictitious second pinned JMdict sense. Role and performer are distinguished.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling and reading; sole sense 1 covers telephone receiver.
rows.sourceNote: Receiver/handset is not the entire telephone or a phone call. Search-only 受話機 is not promoted as an ordinary alternative.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling and reading; sole sense 1 covers circulation, rotation, cycle and loop.
rows.sourceNote: The route-marker wo in intransitive circulation examples is not a transitive object marker. Search-only 循還 is not promoted as an ordinary alternative.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling and reading; sole pinned sense 1 covers police officer/constable.
rows.sourceNote: The actual inspected public Japanese entry supports both the lowest Japanese police rank and the broader officer use; do not restrict every occurrence to either a patrol action or a precise rank assertion.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling and reading; sole sense 1 covers in order, in turn and successively.
rows.sourceNote: 順順 is an alternate spelling. The practical adverbial form 順々に is taught. Iteration mark 々 is not a separate Han character in primary kanji metadata.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling and reading; the raw order/sequence/procedure gloss selects senses 1 and 2.
rows.sourceNote: Sequence/order and procedural steps are both taught. Not a command or purchase-order meaning of English order; no invented suru verb.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling and reading; sole sense 1 covers pure heart, innocence and naivety.
rows.sourceNote: Preserve the raw self-sacrificing devotion gloss as source provenance, but do not teach it as an independently licensed meaning. Noun/na-adjective; personal feelings, not hygiene or chemical purity.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling and reading; sole sense 1 covers pure, genuine and unmixed.
rows.sourceNote: Material and mental purity are both covered. Noun/na-adjective; not a material-only rule or a synonym for physical cleanliness in every context.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling and reading; raw digestion most directly selects food-digestion sense 1.
rows.sourceNote: Mental assimilation sense 2 and consumption/completion sense 3 are additional. Sense 4's transformation is explicitly flagged archaic and not promoted as a modern unrestricted use. Extra uses do not independently acquire N2 status.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling and reading; sole sense 1 covers elementary/primary school pupil.
rows.sourceNote: Names the pupil, not the building. Japanese six-year-school context is qualified, not converted into a universal age definition.

rows.mappingNote: The raw kanji and English fields are empty. Exact source kana/reading identifies the supplied family; explicitly select cannot-be-helped sense 2 as a dictionary-backed editorial teaching anchor, not recovered compiler intent.
rows.sourceNote: Other-way sense 1, pointlessness sense 3, hopeless/troublesome sense 4 and intense-feeling sense 5 are additional, without independent N2 assignments. Usually kana; rare 仕様がない and valid reading しようがない are qualified. Actual Bunpro attachment evidence supports verb te, i-adjective kute and na-adjective de. No unverified productive you-ga-nai contrast is taught.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling and reading; sole sense 1 covers shogi/Japanese chess.
rows.sourceNote: Whole reading しょうぎ is preserved without inventing a constituent ギ reading for 棋. Actual public entry corroborates 将棋を指す and contrasts 囲碁を打つ. Rare spellings are qualified; search-only 將棋 is not promoted.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling and reading; raw vapor/steam selects sense 1.
rows.sourceNote: Vapor is not restricted to water. Sense 2 transport uses are recognized as abbreviations, not labeled archaic or measured as infrequent without evidence. 蒸汽 is an alternate spelling.

rows.mappingNote: Reuse the existing exact-ID じょうぎ ruler article; sense 1 and required examples/readings/components are already taught. Assign the previously absent explicit word level 2 from this mapped source row.
rows.sourceNote: Preserve word ID, primary reading, title, body and all prior metadata except the sourced level addition. Do not import the separate public ていき rules/custom heading or manufacture an alias for it.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling and reading; sole sense 1 covers advanced/upper level, grade or rank.
rows.sourceNote: Noun/no-modifier pattern; not an automatically inferred na-adjective. Not necessarily luxury, the single highest rank, or a senior person's relational status.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling and reading; sole sense 1 covers commerce/trade/business.
rows.sourceNote: Commercial activity or sector, not a company organization by default. Trade overlaps international trade and business operations without licensing an automatic company/management/work clique.

quizGuardRationale: Author hypotheses, not reviewer conclusions. Direct ordinary meanings and actual answer labels govern symmetric nontransitive pairs, not unrestricted Japanese substitutions.

出勤 safeguards event attendance, on-duty 詰める and commuting 通う. A job, occupation or task is not automatically attendance at work. 出張 safeguards broader travel/trip labels, not every leisure excursion or permanent transfer.

寿命 safeguards lifetime/life and service-life overlap, including 命:2 and 生命:2. Daily living/生活 is not automatically duration. 主役 safeguards role and actor labels without equating lead role with directing.
受話器 has no whole-telephone safeguard merely from a component relation. 循環 safeguards actual rotation/circulation meanings of 回転/回る/回す/回り and 通う:3, not every isolated repeat or geometric ring.
巡査 safeguards 警官, familiar おまわりさん and 警察:2 police officer; an organization-only shortcut would miss the last ordinary meaning. A detective role is not entailed.
順々 and 順序 safeguard actual order/turn/sequence labels. 順序 also safeguards 次第:4 order/program and 方法's procedure overlap; command/purchase order is not inferred.

純情 and 純粋 safeguard actual innocence/purity and genuineness overlaps. 清潔:2 and きれい:2 moral purity are not erased by their current hygiene-focused teaching. 単純 and おめでたい supply actual naivety. 生's separate ki purity family is not transferred into the sei/nama article.

消化 safeguards food/mental absorption, understanding, consumption and direct working-through/finishing meanings. A completeness/perfection adjective such as 完全 is not automatically a processing/completion synonym, nor is every noun meaning an edge or final position.

小学生 safeguards broader student/pupil/child labels, not every school type, building or educational occupation. しょうがない safeguards intense feeling, pointlessness and actual troublesome/annoying evaluations; 無理's impossibility is not automatically unavoidable necessity.

将棋 has no safeguard against a different board game merely because English uses chess in its explanatory name. 蒸気 safeguards broader gas labels and the actual abbreviated steam-train meaning, not a cooking action or warm-steaming manner expression.

上級 safeguards actual advanced/high-grade and broader level/rank/class labels, not a senior-person relationship or every excellent/expensive thing. 商業 safeguards trade/business-operation/international-trade overlap, not an automatic company/management/work clique.
